# stalwart_tls_external_report (Data Source)

Stores a TLS aggregate report received from an external source.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) When the report is scheduled to be deleted
- `from` (String) Email address of the report sender
- `member_tenant_id` (String) Identifier for the tenant this report belongs to Requires an Enterprise license.
- `received_at` (String) When the report email was received
- `report` (Attributes) TLS report content (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report))
- `subject` (String) Subject line of the report email
- `to` (Set of String) List of recipient email addresses

<a id="nestedatt--report"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report`

Read-Only:

- `contact_info` (String) Contact information for the reporting organization
- `date_range_end` (String) End of the reporting period
- `date_range_start` (String) Start of the reporting period
- `organization_name` (String) Name of the organization that generated the report
- `policies` (Attributes List) Policy evaluation results for each domain (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report--policies))
- `report_id` (String) Unique identifier for this report

<a id="nestedatt--report--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report.policies`

Read-Only:

- `failure_details` (Attributes List) Details of TLS failures encountered (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--report--policies--failure_details))
- `mx_hosts` (Set of String) MX hostnames covered by the policy
- `policy_domain` (String) Domain the policy applies to
- `policy_strings` (Set of String) Raw policy strings as retrieved
- `policy_type` (String) Type of TLS policy that was evaluated
- `total_failed_sessions` (Number) Number of sessions that failed TLS establishment
- `total_successful_sessions` (Number) Number of sessions that successfully established TLS

<a id="nestedatt--report--policies--failure_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `report.policies.failure_details`

Read-Only:

- `additional_information` (String) Additional context about the failure
- `failed_session_count` (Number) Number of sessions that failed with this error
- `failure_reason_code` (String) Error code or reason string for the failure
- `receiving_ip` (String) IP address of the receiving mail server
- `receiving_mx_helo` (String) HELO/EHLO string of the receiving mail server
- `receiving_mx_hostname` (String) Hostname of the receiving mail server
- `result_type` (String) Type of failure encountered
- `sending_mta_ip` (String) IP address of the sending mail server
